name: controle-sigen
description: Leitura simplificada do inventário bovino do SIGEN+ para o produtor rural

scripts.dev: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/contracts" "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev -w @sigen/web"
scripts.dev:lan: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/contracts" "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev:lan -w @sigen/web"
scripts.dev:tailscale: npm run build:contracts && concurrently -n contracts,api,web -c yellow,blue,green "npm run dev -w @sigen/contracts" "npm run dev -w @sigen/api" "npm run dev -w @sigen/web -- --host $(tailscale ip -4)"
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @sigen/api
scripts.dev:web: npm run build:contracts && npm run dev -w @sigen/web
scripts.build: npm run build:contracts && npm run build -w @sigen/api && npm run build -w @sigen/web
scripts.test: npm run build:contracts && npm run test -w @sigen/api && npm run test -w @sigen/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:contracts && npm run typecheck -w @sigen/api && npm run typecheck -w @sigen/web
scripts.sigen:login: npm run build:contracts && npm run sigen:login -w @sigen/api
scripts.sigen:check: npm run build:contracts && npm run sigen:check -w @sigen/api
scripts.sigen:gta:check: npm run build:contracts && npm run sigen:gta:check -w @sigen/api
